item.title: About
item.description: About Alan Blount I’m an AI/ML Engineer at Google in Boulder, Colorado, where I work on cutting-edge agent systems, memory architectures, and LLMOps solutions. My focus is on building the next generation of intelligent systems that can think, learn, and adapt. Professional Background At Google, I’m deeply involved in: Agent Memory Systems: Designing and implementing memory architectures for AI agents LLMOps Infrastructure: Building robust systems for deploying and managing large language models Agentic Runtimes: Contributing to frameworks that enable autonomous AI agents Open Source & Community I’m the creator of Headroom, a context compression system for AI applications, and actively contribute to various agentic runtime projects including:
